children: Moldova's gross domestic product grew by 0.9% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, the national statistics bureau said on Monday.
Moldova's gross domestic product grew by 2.4% in real terms in 2025. The Economy ministry last month cut its forecast for GDP growth by 0.4 percentage points to 1.8% this year.
